blockers.claim: 請求書は入力中→突合済み→確定 (承認済み)。確定後は訂正のみ (赤黒) (qa-024)
blockers.finding: unsupported: no invoice lifecycle with states 入力中/突合済み exists anywhere in system-spec (0 hits in all chapters, index, requirements definition, spec-state.json). qa-024 only states that 確定 invoices are not rewritten and are corrected by 赤黒訂正; it defines no state machine.

blockers.claim: 請求データは経理チームが所有し、監査ログは内部監査室が閲覧する (qa-016)
blockers.finding: unsupported: data ownership by 経理チーム is not stated in qa-016 (spec-state.json qa_log) or U6 (00-requirements-definition.md); qa-016 only says 請求担当 use it, リーダー approves, 内部監査室 views audit logs. The 閲覧 half is supported; '所有' is invented.

advisories.claim: 全 8 カテゴリの mobile/tablet/desktop-* セルは対象外として確定済み (system-spec/index.md 章一覧)
advisories.finding: fact true (spec-state.json matrix: 40 cells 対象外, appr-001; each chapter カテゴリ別収集状態), but index.md 章一覧 only lists 対応セル with chapter state 確定 and never says 対象外; cite spec-state.json matrix / chapter カテゴリ別収集状態 (appr-001) instead.

advisories.claim: 請求担当 (40 名) ... 月末 3 営業日に突合する (qa-016, qa-026)
advisories.finding: '月末 3 営業日' comes from qa-019 (U6), not qa-016/qa-026; citation should include qa-019.

advisories.claim: 月末 3 営業日の集中利用を前提にする (qa-009)
advisories.finding: qa-009 is superseded_by qa-019 (spec-state.json qa_log; hearing audit closed finding qa-009->qa-019). Fact is supported by qa-029/U2; cite those instead.
